newsitem.title: BURUNDI: Burundi army kills 126 returning refugees - army.
newsitem.headline: Burundi army kills 126 returning refugees - army.

text.p: Some 126 Burundian Hutu refugees expelled by neighbouring Tanzania were all killed upon return by soldiers from the Tutsi-dominated army, an army spokesman said on Saturday.

Lieutenant-Colonel Isaie Nibizi told Reuters the refugees were killed late on Friday after they tried to escape from a detention centre in the northeast province of Muyinga. "They were all shot and killed after they tried to escape from the centre," he said.
